flipAttemptsNew.conclusion: The successful-challenge branch (CONTRADICTION witness, challenger stake refund plus reward) was never exercised on-chain. A challenge submits no new evidence and the second evaluation re-reads the same evidence file with the same prompt, so both rounds return the same signal set for every explicitly stated fact: numeric thresholds (9 tx/55 min, 6 weeks, 8 months, 11 counterparties) counted in both rounds, definitional disputes (ENS as verified identity, exchange hot wallet as same funder, varied amounts alongside a cloned sequence, 11/12 matching transactions) resolved identically in both rounds. No sampling variance appeared in 28 evaluation rounds. This route is systematically closed, not under-tried.
